paragraphs: Latve looks down at the old tower.
“It’ll make my voice louder,” Latve says. “I can use my voice as a weapon.”
A jellyfish rests on her shoulder. One kind puts listeners to sleep, another hypnotizes them, and a third summons a storm. Latve can layer several jellyfish around the same voice.
“It starts with the voice. It all depends on what you wrap it in,” says Latve.
How can Latve combine the effects and still speak through the same interface?
imageAlt: Latve stands beside Dre’Kaar above an old tower with a glowing jellyfish on her shoulder
caption: Latve and Dre’Kaar by the old tower
task: Build the diagram for Latve’s voice, the base jellyfish decorator, and the three concrete decorators. Then try stacking their effects.
concept: Both LatveVoice and JellyfishDecorator implement Voice. The base decorator holds a Voice and forwards speak() to it. Each concrete decorator extends the base and adds its own effect after the wrapped voice speaks. Because each wrapper is itself a Voice, the effects can be stacked.
